common:generalComment.#text: Ethylene oxide is a colorless gas at 25 °C and a mobile liquid at 0 °C. It has a characteristic sweet odor of ether, noticeable when its concentration in air exceeds 500 ppm. It is a versatile compound used in the production of other chemicals for a variety of industrial applications and everyday consumer products, including household cleaners, personal care items and fabrics. It is also used to sterilize medical equipment and other plastics that are sensitive to heat or moisture.
环氧乙烷在 25 °C 时为无色气体，在 0 °C 时为流动液体。它有一种乙醚特有的甜味，当空气中的浓度超过 500 ppm 时，这种甜味就会很明显。环氧乙烷是一种用途广泛的化合物，可用于生产各种工业应用和日常消费品（包括家用清洁剂、个人护理用品和织物）中的其他化学品。它还用于消毒医疗设备和其他对热或湿度敏感的塑料。

common:generalComment.#text: Biological media refer to substances that provide necessary nutrients and conditions for the growth and maintenance of biological entities such as cells or microorganisms outside the natural environment. Biological culture media are crucial for various applications, including microbiology.
生物介质是指在自然环境之外为细胞或微生物等生物实体的生长和维持提供必要营养和条件的物质。它用于细胞培养或组织培养等过程，包括在受控条件下培养细胞。生物培养基对包括微生物学在内的各种应用至关重要。
